source: FantasyPros 2026 consensus/high/low projections supplied by user
kicker_model: 2024-2025 regular-season made-field-goal distance by kicker, shrunk toward the league average with a 10-made-kick prior; unseen kickers use the league average.
dst_model: Expected weekly points-allowed bucket score using the empirical distribution of team-game residuals around team-season mean points allowed, 2021-2025 regular seasons.
scenario_note: FantasyPros high and low rows are preserved as source scenarios. Modeled floor and ceiling are the minimum and maximum custom totals across consensus/high/low, not confidence intervals.
fantasypros_ranking_note: The supplied 192-player ranking represents all 16 required roster slots as starters: 24 QB, 48 RB, 72 WR/TE, 24 K, and 24 DST. Raw rank is retained as market context; projected_starter_pool applies the actual nine-starter lineup, and starter_context_market_rank compresses the market order to those 108 projected starters.
